name: Chris Morillo
strengths: Morillo triggers downhill off backfield keys and presses run fits without wasted steps.
Morillo chases sideline to sideline with clean pursuit angles and still arrives with balance.
Morillo finishes through contact — wraps and drives instead of arm-tackling in the box.
weaknesses: Morillo still adding mass at 6-2 / 198 and needs cleaner block-shed plus more proven coverage drops for every-down LB.
comparison: Morillo comps to Ernest Jones — 6-2 compact LB mold; triggers downhill, finishes in space, and chases with range before packing full MIKE mass.
projection: Morillo projects as a Year 2 SEC rotation LB (special teams Year 1). Ceiling: every-down WILL/MIKE — the compact Florida-bred second-level piece who can chase, finish, and grow into the box.
schemeFit: Morillo fits a modern second-level LB who can run, finish, and steal nickel/edge snaps while adding mass — scheme-flexible WILL/MIKE mold.
staffNotes: Vault film desk re-verified 2026-08-22 from Hudson Hudl. Comp size-matched to Ernest Jones (6-2). NOTE: On3 recruiter Tony White = FSU DC (not UF). Florida staff on file = Greg Gasparato; UF DC is Brad White. Confirm with Charles before FutureCast card copy.
insiderNotes: Morillo is a compact 6-2 Hudson ATH/LB who triggers downhill, finishes with a wrap, and still has range when flow stretches. Florida offered with a June 15 UOV (Gasparato on the UF ladder). Tony White is FSU's defensive coordinator — his On3 tag is Seminole process, not Gainesville. Wins with instincts, chase, and finishing.
recruitingStory: Chris Morillo is a 2028 Hudson (FL) ATH · 4-star · Natl #288 · ATH #15 · FL #38 · 6-2 / 198. Uncommitted. Florida offered with 1 UOV 2026-06-15 (UF ladder coach Greg Gasparato). FSU process tagged to DC Tony White with heavy visit volume (4 UOVs); USF also live.
angle: Hudson LB tape: trigger + finish + chase range. In-state Florida process — do not confuse Tony White (FSU DC) with Brad White (UF DC).
